# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Baseline iteration (no priors). Diagnosed all 16 failing + 10 flaky tasks in `./trajectories/`
with 5 parallel read-only subagents, and read the real scorer
(`third_party/spreadsheetbench/evaluation/evaluation.py`) to confirm the grading contract
before stating it in the prompt.

## Grading contract (verified from evaluation.py)
- Both workbooks loaded `data_only=True` → grader reads CACHED values. A formula written by
  openpyxl has no cached value unless the (fragile) recalc step succeeds → literals are safer.
- `transform_value`: int/float→`round(x,2)`; numeric-looking str→float; datetime→`round(serial,0)`.
  ⇒ int-vs-float and numeric-string-vs-number DO NOT matter. The real failure is a number/date
  stored as NON-numeric text (str vs float ⇒ `type(v1)!=type(v2)` ⇒ auto-fail). "" and None are equal.
- Fill/font color comparison is COMMENTED OUT — only `.value` is graded.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Ignoring pre-filled example cells inside/adjacent to answer range | 50630, 30709, 39046, 51359, 59259, 59667, 5192, 3911 | Agent recomputes & overwrites the worked-example cells instead of reproducing them & using them to validate its rule (type/format/blank convention) | KNOWLEDGE + structure | worked rule + pre-finish checklist |
| 2 | Gold answer is an Excel formula; Python reimpl diverges + `data_only=False` bug | 57090, 57232, 11842, 38332, 59743 | Reimplements Excel semantics (text/num dedup, off-by-one, /2, #N/A) as literals; reads formula cells as strings (`=Jan!A6`) | CAPABILITY-METHOD + conflict | method (data_only=True) + resolve literal-vs-formula conflict |
| 3 | Number/date stored as text string (type mismatch) | 51958, 50630(D) | Wrote `strftime` string where a real datetime/number was expected (or vice-versa) | KNOWLEDGE (contract) | explicit type contract |
| 4 | Formatting-only tasks mutate values | CF_11072, 110-2, (73-45 value side) | Overwrote formulas / invented summary text / rewrote-collapsed rows instead of hiding | KNOWLEDGE (contract) | formatting-only rule + "only values graded" fact |
| 5 | Hardcoding / copying from example/answer tab | 450-9, 5192, 3911 | Copied "Wanted Results" tab or fabricated per-row values; fails on hidden re-run inputs | KNOWLEDGE | "compute generally; grader re-runs on hidden inputs" |
| 6 | Leaving target cells blank from casual phrasing | 55931, 56637 | Left None/"" for lookup misses because instruction said "adjust manually" | KNOWLEDGE | fold into example-matching (fallback to pattern value) |

## Changes made this iteration (all in prompt.md, one restructure preserving every original rule)
| cluster | edit class | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1,6 | worked rule + checklist | "Match the examples already in the sheet": derive one rule, verify it reproduces EVERY pre-filled example exactly (value/type/format/`\xa0`), don't overwrite with a different type, match empty-vs-filled convention, fallback on lookup miss. Pre-finish checklist makes the verify step unavoidable. | Yes — passing tasks with example cells already reproduce them (that's why they pass); rule = their behavior |
| 2 | method + conflict-resolution | `data_only=True` when reading source cells; never write a raw `"=..."` string; keep "prefer literals" but add: literal must match Excel semantics, else replicate the sheet's formula with standard functions. Resolves the old blanket "prefer literals" that pushed wrong Python reimplementations. | Yes — simple-arithmetic passers read literals (same under data_only=True) and still write literals |
| 3 | output contract | "Store a result in its natural type: real number/datetime + number_format; plain string only when genuinely text." Grounded in transform_value. | Yes — passing tasks already write correct types; defers to example cells (fixes 50630-D text case) |
| 4 | output contract | "Only cell VALUES are graded; formatting not compared" + "Formatting-only tasks: don't change values, hide rows for filtering." | Yes — 110-2 t0 (hides rows) already conforms; only value-mutation on format tasks changes |
| 5 | contract | "grader re-runs on 2 hidden inputs; compute from data; never hardcode or copy answer/example tabs." | Yes — all 24 passers compute from input; matches memory `spreadsheetbench-grading-contract` |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the prompt now makes the agent do)
- 50630: wrote datetime into D5 where example row's D is text `'8 Sep 2021\xa0'` → new rule "reproduce every pre-filled example exactly incl. `\xa0`, don't overwrite with a different type" forces text match.
- 30709/39046/51359/59259/59667: recomputed & overwrote pre-filled example cells (E6:E10 / F2:F4 / B15,C15 / J5:L10 / D2:D22) → "verify rule reproduces every example cell; only fill blanks matching the example convention" fixes the divergence and stops breaking already-correct cells.
- 51958: wrote string "09/08/21 10:06"; gold is a real datetime → str vs float type mismatch → "store real datetime + number_format, not a strftime string."
- 57090/57232/11842/38332: read formula cells as strings (`=Jan!A6`) and/or reimplemented FREQUENCY/COUNTIF/SUMPRODUCT with wrong semantics → `data_only=True` + "replicate the sheet's formula for Excel-specific logic" addresses both.
- CF_11072/110-2: overwrote formulas + invented summary text / collapsed rows → "only values graded; formatting-only tasks keep all values, hide rows to filter."
- 450-9/5192/3911: copied "Wanted Results" tab / fabricated values → "grader re-runs on hidden inputs; compute from data, never hardcode/copy answer tabs."

## Blast-radius (SAFE) statement
All edits are ADDITIVE knowledge / conditional rules or a clarified output contract that the 24
passing tasks (94-8, 160-6, 185-13, 353-29, 435-38, 448-11, 458-49, 575-16, 587-38, 41297, 48354,
52021, 53167, 1563, 16511, 44266, 46897, 55060, 55667, 58047, 58147, 55609, 56975, 58109) ALREADY
satisfy — they compute from input, write correct types, reproduce example cells, and don't mutate
values on format tasks. The one rewritten global line ("prefer literals") still prefers literals;
it only ADDS a semantics caveat + formula fallback, so no passing task's action flips. BOUNDED.

## Process & features used
- 5 parallel `general-purpose` subagents (one per trajectory group) for read-only diagnosis; read
  evaluation.py directly to verify the contract. No worktrees needed (single prose file).
- No prior iterations (baseline). Consistent with memory `spreadsheetbench-grading-contract`
  (re-runs on hidden inputs; exact-type on `.value`; don't hardcode).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The exact-type contract facts (int/float & numeric-string equivalence; text-date fails; only
  values graded; formulas need reliable recalc so literals are safer).
- "Match the pre-filled example cells" is the single highest-leverage rule — do not dilute it.

## Deliberately skipped (with reason)
- 73-45: tagged INFRASTRUCTURE (formula-recalc failed) — not a prompt defect; handed back.
- 56996: gold uses volatile `RANDBETWEEN`; target is non-reproducible — unwinnable by prompt.
- 53367: genuine spec ambiguity (user's quoted formula ended in `>0`); weak/ambiguous, not edited.
